title: Beauty is in the AI of the beholder: MLLMs systematically overrate facial attractiveness

bias_targets.methodology: Regressing MLLM attractiveness ratings on face gender and comparing the resulting gender penalties (e.g., lower scores for male faces) against human baseline ratings using multilevel modeling.
Comparing MLLM attractiveness ratings across different face ethnicities (White, Black, West-Asian, East-Asian, mixed) to identify ethnic preferences or penalties relative to human rating baselines.
Measuring the effect of perceived facial age on MLLM attractiveness scores to evaluate whether models replicate the age-based attractiveness penalties observed in human raters.

Analyzing absolute agreement and score distributions to determine if MLLMs systematically inflate attractiveness scores (sycophancy) and avoid the lower end of the rating scale compared to anonymous human raters.
